fullDescription: JARVIS OS is a premium executive-level dashboard design system featuring a high-fidelity glassmorphism aesthetic on a deep minimalist dark mode background (#0a0a0c). It utilizes a sophisticated typography pairing of Plus Jakarta Sans for UI elements and JetBrains Mono for data-heavy metrics. The style is influenced by the clean simplicity of the Arc Browser and Raycast's functional efficiency. It is characterized by large 32px rounded corners, subtle cyan and blue neon glows, and a layout optimized for high-level business intelligence, SaaS administration, and AI operations monitoring. Key features include circular system status indicators, color-coded intelligence cards, and a spacious grid layout that maximizes whitespace and visual clarity.

structured.summary: A futuristic yet professional AI-driven operating system dashboard called JARVIS OS, optimized for executive workstations. It uses a deep charcoal/black background with layers of translucent glass panels, accented by soft cyan lighting and vibrant status indicators. The interface balances high-density data metrics with a breathable, minimalist layout.

style.description: The style is 'Professional Futurist'. It uses a dark core theme (#0a0a0c) with glass components (24px-32px blur). Typography pairs Plus Jakarta Sans (headings/labels) with JetBrains Mono (technical data). Colors are restricted to a primary cyan/blue palette (#22d3ee, #0ea5e9) with functional accents in emerald green (#4ade80), caution yellow, and alert red (#ef4444). Borders are ultra-thin (1px) with low opacity (5-10%) to maintain a sleek, high-end feel.
style.prompt: Create a UI style based on 'Executive Glassmorphism'. Background: #0a0a0c. Panels: 'glass' effect using background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), backdrop-filter: blur(24px), border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05). Border-radius: 24px-32px for main containers, 12px-16px for internal elements. Shadows: Subtle soft-glows using box-shadow: 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.37). Typography: Main font 'Plus Jakarta Sans', weights 400 to 800; Data font 'JetBrains Mono'. Colors: Cyan (#22d3ee) for active states and primary accents, Blue (#0ea5e9) for secondary accents, Green (#4ade80) for positive growth. Animations: Fluid transitions using cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) and subtle hover transforms (translateY(-4px)). Icons: Minimalist stroke icons (Lucide/Feather style).

layout_and_structure.description: A three-column architecture consisting of a sleek fixed sidebar, a central heavy-content workspace, and a right-side contextual briefing panel, all capped by a floating system status bar at the bottom.

prompts.prompt: Width: 256px (w-64). Fixed left. Background: #0a0a0c. Features a brand logo at the top with a gradient icon (cyan to blue) and bold 'JARVIS.' text. Navigation links should have high vertical padding (py-2.5), 12px border radius, and use text-white/50 with cyan-400 for the active state. Include a bottom-aligned status widget in a glass panel showing system 'Active' status.

Large, dynamic text heading (text-5xl, font-extrabold, tracking-tight) like 'Good Afternoon, Boss.'. Below, a sub-header with text-white/40 containing 'Ready for today's mission' and the current date in monospace. On the right, a large clock (text-4xl, font-light, JetBrains Mono) with a small 'System Syncing' indicator.

Multi-column grid containing glass cards with 32px padding. Revenue cards feature large currency values (₹ or $) with top-right growth badges and a bottom row of sub-currency breakdowns in monospace. Channel cards feature a 6px solid color-coded left border (green/yellow/red) to indicate performance health, a small AI Insight box (bg-white/5), and quantitative metrics (Revenue, Views, Growth) aligned horizontally.

Right-hand sidebar content. 'Mission Brief' is a large glass panel (32px padding) containing conversational AI text, highlighted keywords in bold/white, and a primary CTA button (solid cyan, black text, extra-bold uppercase). Below it, a 'Live Activity' feed with small pulse indicators and text-white/30 log entries.

Fixed bottom bar, 80px height, backdrop-blur-xl, top-border 1px white/5. Contains circular SVG progress meters for CPU, GPU, and RAM. Each meter has a diameter of 40px, a 2.5px stroke, and a central percentage in tiny monospace text. Right side contains a 'Free Space' badge and a pulsing 'OS Stable' status indicator.

special_ui_components.description: A minimalist circular progress indicator for hardware metrics.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement an SVG-based circular meter. Diameter: 40px. Background circle: stroke-white/5, stroke-width: 2.5. Active path: stroke-cyan-400 (or purple/emerald), stroke-dasharray: 100, stroke-dashoffset calculated by value. Center text: JetBrains Mono, 8px, font-bold. Label to the right: two-line stack with uppercase tiny label (white/30) and bold value.

special_ui_components.description: A specialized data container for AI-generated summaries within cards.
special_ui_components.prompt: Width: 128px. Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05). Padding: 12px. Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05). Top label: 8px font-black, uppercase, color matching the performance state (emerald/yellow/red). Body text: 10px, text-white/50, 2-line clamp, leading-tight.
